stories.title: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
stories.body: While precise data is classified, publicly available information suggests the US has used up many difficult-to-manufacture weapons.

stories.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
stories.body: A New Mexico judge ordered the Instagram, Facebook and Whatsapp parent company to pay another $567m for the way it has harmed children.

stories.title: Uefa says boycott may still go ahead as FA withdraws Infantino support
stories.body: Fifa's backing of president Gianni Infantino at a meeting on Wednesday "changes nothing", says European governing body Uefa.

stories.title: South Korea space agency shares Moon images after SpaceX rocket debris crash
stories.body: Seoul's lunar orbiter captured images of the Moon before and after part of SpaceX's rocket hit its surface on Wednesday.

stories.title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
stories.body: The Spanish territory's mayor-president also says 100 deaths occurred as a result of 78,000 migrants crossing from neighbouring Morocco.

stories.title: Israel charges settler over killing of Palestinian involved in Oscar-winning West Bank film
stories.body: Yinon Levy is charged with reckless manslaughter over the July 2025 shooting of Odeh Hathaleen.

stories.title: Some of Doge's $110bn saving reports are wrong or lack evidence, US watchdog finds
stories.body: A review of the body formerly charged with reducing government spending has found several issues with its calculations.

stories.title: Trump imposes 15% tariff on key chip material to counter China
stories.body: The move aims to counter Chinese producers, which hold a monopoly in the global polysilicon production.

stories.title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
stories.body: Ukraine's president says the strikes aim to limit revenues Russia "used to finance" its war.

stories.title: Rights groups say Israeli attack that killed Lebanese journalist an apparent war crime
stories.body: Amal Khalil was killed and her colleague Zeinab Faraj wounded in an Israeli attack in April; Israel denied targeting the journalists.

stories.title: TikTok star Sydney Towle, who shared her cancer journey online, dies aged 26
stories.body: Towle was known for chronicling her hopes and struggles as a young person living with cancer.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence used to design brand new viruses
stories.body: Scientists made 16 successful viruses that had their genetic code designed by artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
stories.body: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

stories.title: US Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt over Covid hearing
stories.body: The committee will now refer him for possible prosecution for refusing to answer questions about his handling of the Covid-19 pandemic.

stories.title: DR Congo river boat under quarantine for Ebola after five deaths
stories.body: The health minister says all the passengers are being screened as a precautionary measure.

stories.title: EasyJet agrees to £5.7bn takeover by US firm
stories.body: The no-frills carrier agrees to be bought by US firm Apollo after a rival suitor drops out.

stories.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
stories.body: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.

stories.title: Indian journalist Tarun Tejpal sentenced to 10 years in jail for rape
stories.body: Tejpal, who has denied the accusations, can appeal against the verdict in India's Supreme Court.

stories.title: Rihanna is 'in the studio', says partner A$AP Rocky
stories.body: The singer, who last released a full album in 2016, is in the studio and "cooking", her partner said.

stories.title: Outrage as Ugandan football captain beaten to death in street gang attack
stories.body: The 27-year-old was killed by suspected robbers after resisting an attempt to rob him, police say.
